name: @crc/physics
description: First-class 2D and 3D physics for the CRC component runtime
author: Ben Lesh <ben@benlesh.com>

scripts.build: rimraf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/2d.ts src/2d-geometry.ts src/3d.ts src/3d-geometry.ts --bundle --splitting --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=esnext --sourcemap --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --external:@crc/core --external:@crc/core/internal --external:@crc/webgl --external:@crc/webgl/internal
scripts.test:geometry: vitest run src/lib/2d/public-types.test.ts src/lib/3d/public-types.test.ts src/lib/3d/shapes.test.ts src/lib/3d/collision --browser.enabled=false --environment node
